# Tools reference

<!-- Generated by src/lib/tools/toolsDoc.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:tools`. -->

The Tools page has 135 tools. 101 of them are listed here with the models they load,
one row per engine (a card with an engine picker has several rows): 130 rows,
98 action tools and 32 catalog (LoRA) tools. The other 34 are
multi-step tools and templates (Storyboard, ClipCut, Video Translator, ...) that chain these.
Models are read from the ComfyUI graph each tool queues, so this page tracks the shipped workflows.

- **Commercial** is the most restrictive license among the models a tool loads:
  `yes` (permissive), `restricted` (revenue cap, territory or copyleft condition),
  **no (nc)** (non-commercial weights) or `check license` (the author states no license).
  Details and links: [MODELS.md](../MODELS.md).
- **VRAM** is a weights-only ballpark from the largest main model the tool loads
  (`8 GB` / `12 GB` / `16 GB` / `24 GB`; `24 GB + offload` runs on a 24 GB card with
  ComfyUI's model offloading, slower). `light` = small helper models only. Text encoders
  and VAEs are loaded and released per stage. Run times depend on the GPU and are not listed.
- A card whose models, nodes or pack are missing stays disabled with the reason shown;
  `GET /api/tools/model-status` lists the missing files.

## Action tools

Run through `POST /api/jobs/action` (see [tools-api.md](tools-api.md)).

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Describe | Get prompts for an image | image | Qwen3-VL 4B Instruct (style-library captioner) | yes | n/a (external) | needs the optional style-library service |

## Speech pipelines

Multi-step audio tools on the `audio` pack. They chain several graphs, so they have no row above.

| Tool | Steps | Models |
|---|---|---|
| Video Translator | transcribe (Whisper ASR), translate, re-voice (TTS), optional lipsync | Whisper large-v3-turbo + Qwen3-VL 8B + Chatterbox multilingual or VibeVoice-1.5B + InfiniteTalk |
| Voice Changer | speech-to-speech voice conversion, keeps timing | Chatterbox VC (Resemble AI) · MIT |

## Optional sidecars

Tools backed by a separate service instead of a ComfyUI graph. The card is always listed;
until the service is configured it shows how to run it.

| Tool | Service | Env | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hair Cards (HairDeck) | [HairDeck](https://github.com/hyz317/HairDeck) Gradio demo (`python demo/app.py --port 7860`), reached over its HTTP API | `HAIRDECK_BACKEND_URL` (loopback; `HAIRDECK_ALLOW_REMOTE=1` for a LAN host) | per seed: hair-card `.glb` (with and without head proxy, optional strand chains) and card/chain JSON, saved to `output/adrift_hairdeck`; Export for Blender |

HairDeck by hyz317 is Apache-2.0 (code and checkpoints). Adrift links to it and vendors nothing;
the HairDeck install pulls in models under their own terms:

- HairDeck code + checkpoints: Apache-2.0 (https://github.com/hyz317/HairDeck)
- SAM 3 (hair segmentation, gated): SAM License (https://huggingface.co/facebook/sam3)
- DINOv3 (image encoder, gated): DINOv3 License (https://huggingface.co/facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m)
- BiRefNet matting: MIT (https://github.com/ZhengPeng7/BiRefNet)
- Blender + VRM Add-on (optional VRM export): GPL (https://www.blender.org/about/license/)

VRM export needs HairDeck's session state, so it runs in the HairDeck UI or CLI, not through Adrift.
